title: CANADA STOCKS-Futures slip as Apple's slashed quarter forecast hurts global stocks By Reuters
text:
© Reuters. CANADA STOCKS-Futures slip as Apple's slashed quarter forecast hurts global stocks Jan 3 (Reuters) - Futures for Canada's main stock index pointed to a lower opening on Thursday, following a broad selloff in Asian and European markets after Apple cut its sales forecast of its first fiscal quarter.
March futures on the S&P/TSX index SXFc1 were down 0.91 percent at 7:00 a.m. ET.
Investors sought safety in bonds and less risky assets amid renewed concerns about slowing global economic and corporate growth. Inc AAPL.O on Wednesday cut its sales forecast for its first fiscal quarter ended Dec. 2018, with Chief Executive Tim Cook blaming slowing iPhone sales in China. Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX .GSPTSE ended 24.30 points, or 0.17 percent, higher at 14,347.16.. Jones Industrial Average e-mini futures 1YMc1 were down 1.4 percent at 7:00 a.m. ET, S&P 500 e-mini futures ESc1 were down 1.4 percent and Nasdaq 100 e-mini futures NQc1 were down 2.2 percent. .N
TOP STORIES TOP/CAN
China's top prosecutor said that two Canadians detained in China after Canada arrested a Chinese technology company executive had "without a doubt" violated the law. new Barrick Gold Corp GOLD.N ABX.TO is considering options for its stake in Acacia Mining AACA.L including possible sale, as Barrick works to end a nearly two-year-long tax dispute in Tanzania that has effectively shuttered operations there, CEO Mark Bristow said on Wednesday. Syncrude has been directed to pay C$2.75 million after it pleaded guilty over the death of 31 blue herons at its oil sands site in northern Alberta, the Canadian province's energy regulator said.
